description: This file defines inline functions for updating Ethernet network statistics, such as bytes transmitted/received, packet counts, broadcast/multicast counts, and error counts, conditioned on the CONFIG_NET_STATISTICS_ETHERNET configuration.

methods.name: eth_stats_update_bytes_rx
methods.description: Updates the received bytes counter for a network interface.

methods.name: eth_stats_update_bytes_tx
methods.description: Updates the transmitted bytes counter for a network interface.

methods.name: eth_stats_update_pkts_rx
methods.description: Increments the received packets counter for a network interface.

methods.name: eth_stats_update_pkts_tx
methods.description: Increments the transmitted packets counter for a network interface.

methods.name: eth_stats_update_unknown_protocol
methods.description: Increments the counter for unknown protocol errors.
